abstract: A 26-year-old man was admitted to our hospital for an examination of a mediastinal tumor. Chest computed tomography(CT) showed a giant anterior mediastinal tumor narrowing the trachea and right main bronchus. Although needle biopsy could not be done because of patient respiratory condition, non-seminomatous mediastinal germ cell malignant tumor was strongly suspected by high level of serum AFP without no abnormal finding in his testis. After 1 cycle of chemotherapy by cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, the mediastinal tumor decreased in size. Percutaneous biopsy was challenged, however, definite diagnosis could not be established and the surgical resection was performed. The tumor was pathologically diagnosed as mature teratoma with elements of a yolk-sac tumor and some sort of sarcoma. Sudden onset of back pain and thrombocytopenia were encountered 5 months after the operation. Hematologic examination confirmed acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, and remission-induction therapy and allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation were performed. Twelve months after the operation, the patient is well without recurrence of either disease.
abstract_ja: 26歳の男性が縦隔腫瘍の精査のため当院に入院した。胸部CTでは、気管および右主気管支を狭窄させる巨大な前縦隔腫瘍が認められた。患者の呼吸状態のため針生検は実施できなかったが、血清AFPの高値から、精巣に異常所見がないにもかかわらず、非セミノーマ性縦隔胚細胞悪性腫瘍が強く疑われた。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を1コース施行したところ、縦隔腫瘍は縮小した。経皮生検を試みたが確定診断には至らず、外科的切除が行われた。腫瘍は病理学的に、卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分とある種の肉腫の成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後5か月で突然の背部痛と血小板減少が出現した。血液学的検査で急性巨核芽球性白血病と確定し、寛解導入療法および同種造血幹細胞移植を実施した。術後12か月の時点で、患者は両疾患の再発なく良好な状態である。
